name: CMF Buds Pro 2
notes: Model code 87b1 and firmware 1.0.1.74 read from the device; protocol 1.0.1. ⚠️ THIS MODEL ACKNOWLEDGES EVERY QUERY, answering unsupported ones with an empty payload rather than staying silent like the Ear (3a) — so a probe must treat a zero-length reply as 'unsupported', not as a value. Codec values are left unlisted: 0xC029 answers 0x00, so a selector exists, but which values are real here has not been read back. The case carries a volume dial: the gesture table exposes it as side 0x04 (neither 0x02 left nor 0x03 right) with TWO button ids, 0x01 and 0x09 — the only place where that field is not constant. All its rows carry action 0x01, so its functions appear to be fixed rather than remappable. Absent on this model: advanced EQ (0xC06C/0xC06D), the Mimi group (0xC022-0xC025), and 0xC062.
